evals.name: cif-validation-build
evals.prompt: I'm a supplier preparing a CIF catalog for SAP Business Network. My header has LOADMODE=X and CURRENCY=USdollars, and one item row has a UnitPrice of -5.00 with a ClassificationCode (UNSPSC) of 123. What will fail validation, what's the severity, and how do I fix them?
evals.expected_output: Identifies LOADMODE_VALID error (must be F or I), CURRENCY_VALID error (not ISO 4217; use USD), PRICE_POSITIVE error (must be >= 0), UNSPSC_FORMAT issue (123 not valid 2/4/6/8 digits). Gives rule names and fixes.

evals.name: cxml-anonymize-blanket
evals.prompt: I need to anonymize a blanket-order cXML document before loading it into Test Central. What gets replaced, what's preserved, and what happens to the agreement fields?
evals.expected_output: Header tokens (#PAYLOADID# etc.), 14 PRESERVE_EXTRINSIC_NAMES kept, mapped extrinsics replaced. Blanket: parentAgreementID→#PARENT_AGREEMENTID#, effectiveDate→yesterday, expirationDate→+100y. Security: defusedxml + hardened lxml.

evals.name: catalog-type-and-timeline
evals.prompt: A supplier wants live pricing AND buyers need to search items in Ariba. Which catalog type? How long does integration take?
evals.expected_output: PunchOut Level 2 (live pricing + item-level search). Integration: 7 phases, 10-12 weeks first-time.

evals.name: cms-vs-noncms-fields
evals.prompt: What's the difference between CMS and Non-CMS realms? How many fields does each support and what load modes are available?
evals.expected_output: CMS: 81 fields, LOADMODE=F only, accepts Excel, classification required. Non-CMS: 75 fields, F+I, UNSPSC required. Lists the 6 CMS-only fields.

evals.name: managed-gateway-setup
evals.prompt: Walk me through setting up Managed Gateway for a new buyer integration.
evals.expected_output: Prerequisites (Role, enable in Settings). 6 steps: Basic Info, Connection (HTTPS/AS2/VAN), Document Routing, Cross-References, Connection Test, Activate. Explains AS2 vs HTTPS vs VAN with cert requirements.

evals.name: supply-chain-forecast
evals.prompt: How does forecast collaboration work on SAP Business Network? What messages are exchanged?
evals.expected_output: Buyers share demand forecasts, suppliers commit to deliveries. Product activity messages (buyer→supplier) and replenishment messages (supplier→buyer). Integrates with SAP IBP.

evals.name: bn4l-freight-collaboration
evals.prompt: What are the core capabilities of SAP BN4L and how does freight collaboration work?
evals.expected_output: 5 capabilities: Freight Collaboration, GTT, Dock Scheduling, Material Traceability, Intelligent Insights. Freight lifecycle: plan in TM → tender via BN4L → carrier confirms → execute → milestones → settlement → invoice.

evals.name: sap-api-endpoints
evals.prompt: What are the cXML endpoint URLs for SAP Business Network and what authentication options are available?
evals.expected_output: US: s1.ariba.com, EU: s1-eu.ariba.com, AU: s1.au.cloud.ariba.com, JP: s1.jp.cloud.ariba.com, CN: s1.sapariba.cn. Auth: Shared Secret, Digital Certificates, OAuth 2.0, Basic Auth.

evals.name: validate-xml-cxml-org
evals.prompt: Can you validate my cXML document against the official cXML.org DTD?
evals.expected_output: References DTD at http://xml.cXML.org/schemas/cXML/1.2.069/cXML.dtd. Explains validation approach: check DOCTYPE declaration, validate structure against schema, verify required elements and attributes.

evals.name: convert-cif-to-xls
evals.prompt: I have a .cif file and need to convert it to .xls format. Can you help?
evals.expected_output: Parses CIF text (header keywords + FIELDNAMES + DATA rows), maps columns to Excel sheet, writes .xls using openpyxl. Validates output against processing rules.

evals.name: convert-xls-to-cif
evals.prompt: I have a catalog in Excel format and need to convert it to CIF text format for upload to SBN.
evals.expected_output: Reads Excel columns, detects/maps to CIF FIELDNAMES, generates CIF 3.0 text with proper header (CIF_I_V3.0, CHARSET, CODEFORMAT, LOADMODE, etc.), DATA rows, ENDOFDATA. Applies formula-injection neutralization.

evals.name: generate-cxml-mime
evals.prompt: Can you generate a cXML MIME file (CatalogUploadRequest) for submitting my catalog to SAP Business Network?
evals.expected_output: Generates multipart/related MIME with: payloadID, boundary, NetworkID credentials, operation=update, Part 1 (text/xml cXML envelope), Part 2 (catalog.cif or catalog.zip). Uses cXML version 1.2.069 DTD.

evals.name: invoice-po-flip
evals.prompt: A supplier wants to create an invoice from a received PO on SAP Business Network. Walk them through the PO Flip process.
evals.expected_output: Navigate to PO in SBN inbox → Create Invoice → header fields pre-populated → review/adjust quantities and prices → add tax details → submit. Mentions status lifecycle: Draft → Submitted → Sent → Approved/Rejected.

evals.name: invoice-rejection-troubleshoot
evals.prompt: My invoice was rejected by the buyer on SBN. The reason says 'Invoice amount exceeds PO tolerance'. What should I do?
evals.expected_output: Explains tolerance rules (buyer-configured in transaction rules). Advises: check PO line amounts vs invoice, ensure quantities match, consider partially invoicing if allowed, contact buyer to understand their tolerance %, possibly issue credit memo and resubmit.

evals.name: credit-memo-creation
evals.prompt: How do I create a credit memo on SAP Business Network?
evals.expected_output: Invoices → Credit Memo → select original invoice → enter credit amount → submit. Must reference original invoice number. Use cases: returns, overbilling, pricing adjustments. Line-level credit also available for partial corrections.

evals.name: generate-asn-cxml
evals.prompt: Generate a cXML ShipNoticeRequest (ASN) for a shipment I'm sending to my buyer.
evals.expected_output: Generates ShipNoticeRequest with ShipNoticeHeader (shipmentID, shipmentDate, carrier), ShipNoticePortion (per PO), ShipNoticeItem (per line). Includes tracking number, ship-from address, estimated delivery date. References DTD 1.2.069.

evals.name: order-confirmation-cxml
evals.prompt: I want to confirm a purchase order but propose a different delivery date. How do I send an OC with changes?
evals.expected_output: ConfirmationRequest with ConfirmationHeader type=accept_changes. ConfirmationItem carries updated deliveryDate. Explains response types: accept, accept_changes, reject. References 11 standard rejection reason codes.

evals.name: edifact-message-identification
evals.prompt: I'm a supplier in Japan and my buyer wants me to send ship notices via EDI. Which EDIFACT message type do I need and how is it set up?
evals.expected_output: DESADV D96A (Despatch Advice). Direction: Inbound (Supplier→Buyer). cXML equivalent: ShipNoticeRequest. Set up via Managed Gateway: enable EDIFACT channel, set D96A version, map fields. Test with Test Central. Links to spec PDF.

evals.name: supplier-registration
evals.prompt: I received a TRR email from a new buyer. What do I need to do to complete registration on SAP Business Network?
evals.expected_output: Click link in TRR email → registration page → choose Enterprise or Standard → enter company details (legal name, address, tax ID, DUNS) → create admin user → accept T&Cs → ANID assigned (AN + 11 digits). Complete profile: banking, certifications, payment preferences.

evals.name: document-routing-setup
evals.prompt: How do I configure document routing on SBN so POs are automatically sent to my ERP system?
evals.expected_output: Settings → Electronic Order Routing → choose method: cXML HTTP (enter endpoint URL), EDI via Managed Gateway (channel config), Email PDF, or Portal. Can set per document type and per customer. Priority: Customer-specific → Doc-type → Default.

evals.name: buyer-transaction-rules
evals.prompt: As a buyer admin, what transaction rules can I configure for invoice validation?
evals.expected_output: Tolerance rules (accept within X% of PO), duplicate invoice check, required tax fields (tax ID, rate, amount), date rules (reject if older than N days), line-level PO matching requirement, ASN required before invoice, PO acknowledgement required. Location: Administration → Transaction Rules.

evals.name: gitp-integration-process
evals.prompt: What is GITP and how does a supplier use it to prepare for integration?
evals.expected_output: Guided Integration for Trading Partners. 5 steps: Enter GITP (Integration tab), Complete Integration Profile (capabilities + doc types), Compatibility Dashboard (traffic-light buyer matching), Compare & Reconcile Templates (SAP Golden vs buyer template), Map in Managed Gateway. Lists 11 OC rejection codes.

evals.name: bn4l-gtt-milestones
evals.prompt: What event types does BN4L GTT support for tracking shipments?
evals.expected_output: Lists planned events (DEPARTURE, ARRIV_DEST, LOAD_BEGIN/END, UNLOAD_BEGIN/END, COUPLING, DECOUPLING, POPU, POD) and unplanned events (DELAYED, GEOLOC, DELIVERED, POD, EXCEPTION, etc.). Notes CUSTOMS_CLEARED is custom event. Mentions event reason codes.

evals.name: bn4l-carrier-onboarding
evals.prompt: How does a carrier get onboarded to SAP BN4L?
evals.expected_output: 5 phases: Shipper invites via Discover and Invite Carriers app → Carrier receives email, places SAP Store order, activates tenant → Accepts connection in Manage Invitations → Shipper maps LBN ID to carrier BP (LBN001) → Carrier creates Technical User and configures outbound connection.

evals.name: bn4l-dock-scheduling
evals.prompt: How does dock appointment scheduling work in BN4L?
evals.expected_output: Carrier self-books via Self-Book Dock Appointments tile → selects FO from Ready for Booking list → picks slot → Booked. Gate check-in via Manage Gate Operations. Supports guest user (driver) booking via time-limited URL. Recurring block times configurable.

evals.name: oauth-setup-apj
evals.prompt: I need to set up OAuth 2.0 for API access from my Australian SAP Business Network account. What's the token endpoint and how do I get a token?
evals.expected_output: AU token URL: https://api.au.cloud.ariba.com/v2/oauth/token. Client credentials grant: POST with Basic auth (base64 of client_id:client_secret), grant_type=client_credentials. Use token as Bearer in API calls to https://openapi.au.cloud.ariba.com/.

evals.name: india-einvoicing
evals.prompt: I'm an Indian supplier on SBN. What are the e-invoicing requirements I need to follow?
evals.expected_output: AATO above ₹5 Crore requires IRN from IRP. IRN = SHA-256 of Supplier GSTIN + Invoice Number + Doc Type + FY. QR code with 8 parameters. 30-day reporting rule from April 2025 for ≥₹10Cr. Path: ERP generates JSON → IRP returns IRN + QR → submit to buyer via SBN.

evals.name: japan-jct-qualified-invoice
evals.prompt: What is the Japan Qualified Invoice System and how does it affect suppliers on SBN?
evals.expected_output: Effective Oct 2023. Buyers can only claim JCT input tax credit from registered issuers. T-number: T + 13 digits. Configure in SBN: Administration → Legal Profile. 7 mandatory fields on qualified invoice. Transitional: 80% credit from non-registered (2023-2026), 50% (2026-2029), 0% after.

evals.name: australia-peppol
evals.prompt: Does SAP Business Network support Peppol e-invoicing for Australian suppliers?
evals.expected_output: SBN is eInvoicing Ready: Receive Only. Full send/receive requires SAP DRC Peppol Service. Format: PINT A-NZ (mandatory since May 2025, BIS 3.0 retired). ABN used as Peppol Participant ID. NCEs must receive Peppol since July 2022; 30% target by July 2026.

evals.name: sbn-discovery-profile
evals.prompt: How can I optimize my supplier profile on SAP Business Network Discovery to be found by more buyers?
evals.expected_output: Key levers: UNSPSC category selection (broad + specific, up to 50 codes), 7 certification categories (Environmental, Energy, Diversity, Quality, Security, Social Enterprise, Other), profile completeness, Verified badge, Promote subscription for higher ranking. Posting responses are free.

evals.name: dynamic-discounting
evals.prompt: What is dynamic discounting on SAP Business Network and how does it work?
evals.expected_output: Buyer-funded early payment. 3 types: SEPTO (standing auto-apply), Buyer-Initiated Ad Hoc, Supplier-Initiated. Calculation: Discount = Amount × (APR/365) × Days Early. Auto-acceptance rules configurable. VAT regions: credit memo auto-generated for discount amount.

evals.name: temp-labor-timesheet
evals.prompt: How do I create and submit a time sheet for temporary labor on SBN?
evals.expected_output: Fulfillment → Time Sheets → Create Time Sheet → reference Service PO → enter worker reference, service period, hours per day → attach supporting docs → submit. Buyer reviews and approves. After approval, create Service Invoice.

evals.name: report-scheduling
evals.prompt: How do I set up a scheduled invoice summary report on SAP Business Network?
evals.expected_output: Reports → Reporting → Create Report → select Invoice Summary type → set date range and filters → save as template. Schedule: daily/weekly/monthly delivery via email or download. Format: CSV, Excel, or PDF.

evals.name: freight-dispute
evals.prompt: A carrier submitted an invoice with charges that don't match the freight order. How are disputes handled in BN4L?
evals.expected_output: System detects mismatch → Dispute created (In Dispute) → Shipper reviews in Manage Disputes → Accept/Reject/Counter-proposal. If accepted: Submitted for Confirmation → TM confirms → Resolved. Auto-approval if within tolerance. Multi-step internal approval workflow configurable.
